name: cx-goal-many-rules
task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) hard commands the box pickup; the hard RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) captures 'move the ball away before you take the key'; the soft Absence(key_lost) captures 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed'; the soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) captures the preference 'whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards'.

texts: If the ball has been moved away from the door, then the agent has the door key before or after that.
The agent never loses the key while the door is closed.
Whenever the agent has the door key, the door must be open at that moment or afterwards.
The agent eventually picks up the target box.
